description: This file contains the class JsonRpcSerializer which is responsible for preparing JSON-RPC requests for transfer within the AWS SDK for PHP. It includes methods for serializing commands into HTTP requests, configuring headers, and managing endpoint details.

classes.name: JsonRpcSerializer
classes.description: Class responsible for serializing AWS commands into JSON-RPC HTTP requests, handling endpoint configuration and request headers.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the serializer with service details, endpoint, and optional JSON formatter.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Serializes a command into an HTTP request with appropriate headers and body, ready to be sent.
